mode: Reused generated photographic artwork and paper presentation; authored exact-font native SVG wrapping. Landscape paper is presented with an identical rotation in both variants. No new image generation or font preparation.

wrapping_record.method: Greedy whole-word wrapping measured by Chromium canvas with the exact embedded static font, kerning normal, no hyphenation; text, font size and baseline interval fixed.

fontLicensePolicy: The existing renamed Source Sans 3 Regular instance is reused unchanged with source and OFL notice retained. The same static font, optical design and weight400 are used in both variants.
comparisonPolicy: Guide: measure725 to480, four lines to six. Care: measure180 to390, eight lines to four. Report: summary measure725 to480, three lines to four; table retains width725 and all geometry/values. All measures are artwork layout units. Only text width and resulting whole-word wrapping change. The source paragraph, typeface, size, weight, line spacing, left anchor, first baseline, photography/crops, paper and lighting remain fixed. No copy is shortened and no manual editorial breaks are inserted.

verification.textBounds: within the declared paper or phone surface
verification.pixelCheck: Only intended declared line-measure intervention regions differ.
verification.scope: Six saved desktop/narrow browser views visually inspected. The one embedded font loads; SVG img output equals inline rendering byte for byte. Same-origin pixel checks find no changes outside prose reflow regions. Browser checks validate rendered line advances against each measure and reject unnecessary early breaks when the next word would fit. Exact DOM checks preserve copy, font/size/weight, leading, left edge, first baseline, photo bytes/crops, paper presentation and unrelated table geometry. Text remains within each paper and no horizontal overflow occurs. Full-size vector links support inspection of landscape details on narrow screens. Article-renderer markup is checked separately.

limitations: No reader study, measured performance improvement, physical print trial, implemented responsive maximum-width behavior, full accessibility evaluation or production-route result. Character counts include spaces and omit trailing line-end spaces. The examples are English-language cases, not rules for other scripts. Landscape details need full-size inspection on narrow screens. Other briefs can legitimately use the before measures.
